title.value: Non-normal Recurrent Neural Network (nnRNN): learning long time dependencies while improving expressivity with transient dynamics
title.justification: The title directly reflects the primary focus of the paper, which is on nnRNN, a novel architecture that addresses long-term dependencies in RNNs by introducing non-normal dynamics.
title.quote: Non-normal Recurrent Neural Network (nnRNN): learning long time dependencies while improving expressivity with transient dynamics

analysis.description: This paper introduces the Non-normal Recurrent Neural Network (nnRNN), which enhances expressivity in recurrent neural networks while maintaining stable long-term signal propagation. By leveraging a novel connectivity structure using Schur decomposition, nnRNN allows for non-orthogonal eigenbases, which provides a richer space for matrix parameterization. The architecture stabilizes learning of long sequences by maintaining unit-norm eigenvalues while enhancing transient dynamics for tasks requiring ongoing computations.
